ValidationRule.description: requires onboarding to have closed won reasons when closing a case
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Onboarding', ISBLANK(TEXT( Closed_Won_Reason__c )), CONTAINS( $UserRole.Name, 'Onboarding'), ISCHANGED( Status ), ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Closed') )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Closed Won Reason is required upon closing the case
